metadata.description: The Agenthood Society — 20 specialized agent skills for the full software engineering lifecycle: architecture, TDD, implementation, debugging, code review, security audit, commit messages, changelogs, documentation, institutional knowledge, cross-provider validation, drift detection, code smell enforcement, context stewardship, first-in-line intent routing, message delivery, visual inspection, runtime operations, goal refinement, and release management.

plugins.name: agenthood-all
plugins.description: All 20 Agenthood members — every skill for every stage of the engineering lifecycle. Architecture, TDD, implementation, debugging, code review, security audit, commit messages and PR descriptions, changelogs, documentation, institutional knowledge, cross-provider translation, structural drift detection, code smell enforcement, context management, first-in-line intent routing, message delivery, visual inspection, goal refinement, runtime operations, and release management.

plugins.name: agenthood-engineering
plugins.description: Engineering workflow skills: commit messages & PR descriptions (scribe), spec-first architecture planning (architect), goal refinement and requirement discovery (strategist), TDD test generation (tester), and systematic error diagnosis (debugger).

plugins.name: agenthood-validation
plugins.description: Validation and quality skills: multi-axis code review (reviewer), security & dependency audit (auditor), commit/PR/branch convention enforcement (doorman), cross-member contradiction detection (sentinel), and code smell & complexity enforcement (warden).

plugins.name: agenthood-knowledge
plugins.description: Knowledge and documentation skills: API references, ADRs, READMEs (librarian) and institutional knowledge about member format, naming conventions, and Society structure (oracle).

plugins.name: agenthood-lifecycle
plugins.description: Release lifecycle skills: semantic versioning, changelogs, release notes (herald), cross-provider translation and bootstrap generation (envoy), runtime health, deployments, rollback (operator), and context window management and member routing (steward).
